verification.productionArtifacts: 3 Reactus artifacts and 7 SQL assets verified
verification.specialistAudits: backend PASS, contract/security PASS, UI PASS

acceptance.crossInstanceRealtime: Edits, row-order changes, and shared-view changes propagated between independent signed-in sessions on two server instances without manual refresh.
acceptance.savedViews: Private/shared discovery and permission-aware create, update, duplicate, apply, and delete behavior passed without private-event leakage.
acceptance.replay: Disconnect/reconnect and explicit Last-Event-ID replay applied missed events once, in order, from the last committed cursor.
acceptance.revocation: Session and access revocation stopped later delivery, disclosed no later row data, and surfaced the recovery state.
acceptance.rowOrder: Shared row order moved and converged live; a sorted view disabled move authority and the pointer-handle mount while preserving sorted rows and logical selection across remount.
acceptance.focus: Delete confirmation focused Cancel, trapped Tab between two actions, inactivated and visually suppressed the background, and restored the originating Delete action on Escape.
acceptance.console: No warning or error entries in the final browser runs.
acceptance.cleanup: Browser finalized, viewport reset, fixtures and temporary files removed, ports released, and PostgreSQL container removed.
